description: This file contains unit tests for diagnostic event functionalities, including emitting events, handling listeners, and safeguards like recursion guards and enabling flags.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite named 'diagnostic-events' for organizing related tests.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup function invoked before each individual test to reset diagnostic events.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Cleanup function invoked after each test, resetting diagnostic events and restoring mocks.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for various behaviors of diagnostic event system.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertions to verify expected outcomes in each test case.

methods.name: vi.spyOn
methods.description: Creates spies on functions (like console.error or Date.now) to monitor calls and mock returns.

methods.name: vi.restoreAllMocks
methods.description: Restores all mocks to their original implementations after test execution.

ctags.name: events
ctags.pattern: /^    const events: Array<{ seq: number; ts: number; type: string }> = [];$/
